title: S04T08 - Add console conflict, blocker, and next-step states
description: Make directive conflicts, missing required directives, blockers, and next workflow recommendations visible and actionable in the console.
acceptanceCriteria: Console distinguishes required blockers from warnings and shows safe next commands or workflow refs without hiding conflicts.
closedReason: S04T08 criteria satisfied: console distinguishes directive conflicts, missing required data, blockers, and safe next workflow commands from ordinary warnings.
